name: admin.conversations.disconnectShared
purpose: Disconnect a connected channel from one or more workspaces.

channel_id.desc: The channel to be disconnected from some workspaces.

leaving_team_ids.desc: Used for disconnecting a team from a shared channel. Only one team ID may be passed at a time.

safety_note_for_agents: This catalog documents Slack's UNDOCUMENTED/internal API surface for a specific workspace (Hack Club, Enterprise Grid). Calling an undocumented method with params_known=false means you would be guessing params against a real backend with unknown side effects -- do not do this against a real account/token without a human in the loop, and never call anything shaped like a write (*.delete, *.set, *.remove, *.create, *.update, and similar) without explicit human confirmation and a clear understanding of the blast radius, even when params_known=true.
